plans.close_all: Close all positions and cancel entry orders if total account equity reaches $9,700, including unrealized P&L, fees and funding; stop trading for the week. Otherwise flatten and cancel all orders by 2026-10-25T23:50:00Z. Protective stops remain active throughout; gaps and slippage can exceed planned losses.
plans.hostage_policy: At this reallocation, fix each layer's entry notional at $2,500 against $2,500 collateral: 1x leverage. Maintain four slots but activate at most two simultaneously, leaving two in reserve. Maximum one position per symbol and one net short across BTC, ETH and HYPE. Each entry must have estimated loss to its stated stop, including costs, no greater than $100; otherwise skip rather than enlarge risk. Aggregate open stop-risk must remain at or below $200. Never average down, widen stops, increase notional to recover losses, or treat collateral as an acceptable loss budget. A losing position may remain only while its original thesis, stop and time limit remain valid. Realized net profits may offset closing a losing position, but evaluate combined realized and unrealized results: harvesting winners alone does not repair equity. Do not recycle profits into larger positions this week.
plans.rationale: Capital preservation and selective rotation take precedence over filling all layers. BTC offers conditional two-way opportunities around weekly VWAP; ETH and HYPE show weaker historical trend structure, while XMR shows relative strength but elevated positive funding and extension risk. The chosen 1x leverage is below every watchlist symbol's maximum. Supplied marks, final candle closes and VWAP distance fields are not synchronized or internally consistent; use raw price levels as provisional references, disregard supplied distance percentages, and require refreshed timestamp-aligned prices and completed candles before activating any setup. No qualifying confirmation means no trade.
